systemStatus.snapshotHint: This current snapshot reuses the health and Worker APIs; it does not add history or alert configuration.
systemStatus.controlUnavailable: Control status is unreachable or returned an invalid response.

cache.title: {{worker}} cache
cache.scopeHint: Facts and operations apply only to this Runtime Worker. Paths, code, source scope and credentials are never displayed.
cache.requestFailed: The cache operation was not accepted. Refresh the current facts and try again.
cache.operationPollFailed: The current operation could not be refreshed.
cache.operationsLoadFailed: Older operations could not be loaded.
cache.failedCleanupsLoadFailed: More failed cleanup requests could not be loaded.
cache.pollStopped: Automatic updates stopped after two minutes. The operation remains visible; refresh to check it again.
cache.policyDetails: All effective Worker cache policy values
cache.previewRecheckHint: Preview is an estimate. The Worker rechecks every selected key and protection rule when the operation runs.
cache.previewCandidate: No retention reason in this preview; execution still rechecks safety
cache.cleanConfirmDescription: The Worker will recheck {{count}} selected keys and retain any key that is no longer safe to remove.
cache.proofCommitmentDescription: The platform does not prove these sources automatically. Offline material must be current, immutable and cover every dependency. A managed online source must be controlled, repeatable and currently available. An identity change or expiry invalidates this proof; pinning always takes precedence.
cache.failedRetryHint: Retry rechecks Control and Worker state against this observed failure record.
cache.failedGuardsIncomplete: Only part of the failed guard set is shown.
cache.failedGuardCursor: Worker continuation cursor. Refresh after a newer bounded sample; this view does not merge samples.

stateDescriptions.unsupported: This Worker has not advertised cache governance support. No cache request is available.
stateDescriptions.offline: The Worker is offline. Stored facts may be shown, but new cache requests are disabled.
stateDescriptions.missing: Control has not received a cache sample from this Worker.
stateDescriptions.stale: The latest sample is older than the freshness boundary. Refresh after the Worker reports again.
stateDescriptions.owner_unconfirmed: The Worker could not prove exclusive ownership of this cache. Operations are disabled.
stateDescriptions.incomplete: This is one bounded sample. It must not be combined with another sample to invent a complete total.
stateDescriptions.complete: The current bounded sample is complete.

errors.cache_snapshot_changed: The selected key changed after it was observed. Current facts were refreshed.
errors.cache_snapshot_key_missing: A selected key is no longer in the latest snapshot.
errors.cache_snapshot_unavailable: The current snapshot cannot authorize this operation.
errors.cache_operation_active: This Worker already has an active cache operation.
errors.cache_worker_unsupported: This Worker does not support cache governance.
errors.cache_idempotency_conflict: This retry key belongs to a different request.
errors.cache_retry_target_unavailable: The selected operation cannot be retried.
errors.cleanup_retry_active: The cleanup already has a retry in progress.
errors.cache_operation_not_found: The cache operation no longer exists.

managedInput.title: Managed Input
managedInput.allowManualDelete: Allow users to retain files until deleted
managedInput.policyHint: Every field is a bounded, non-empty policy. Lowering quotas does not delete existing files; background cleanup can still reduce usage.
managedInput.quotaReductionHint: Lowering quotas does not delete existing files; over-quota state blocks new uploads or replacements while allowing usage-reducing deletion.
managedInput.overQuota: Managed Input usage is over quota
managedInput.overQuotaDescription: Platform total is {{platform}}; adapters over quota: {{adapters}}. Delete files or wait for background cleanup to release space.
managedInput.disabled: Managed file input is not enabled yet

credentialGuide.title: Credential types
credentialGuide.description: Choose the type that matches the target system's fields; use Generic Secret when none fits.
credentialGuide.createHint: Use when the target requires a username and password
credentialGuide.tokenHint: Use when the target provides one Token
credentialGuide.accessKeyHint: Use when the target provides an Access Key ID and Secret
credentialGuide.secretHint: Use when the other three types do not fit; do not use it for Access Key pairs

password.scenarios: Databases, SSH, FTP/SFTP, HTTP Basic and device logins

token.scenarios: API Tokens, Bearer Tokens, PATs and Webhook Tokens

access_key.scenarios: Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Tencent Cloud, object storage and cloud API request signing

secret.fields: value (for api_key, client_secret, signing_secret, private_key and similar values)
secret.scenarios: Third-party API keys, OAuth client secrets, signing keys and encryption keys

credentials.metadataNotice: Metadata only; Secret values are never shown.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.updateHint: Updates re-encrypt and replace the saved value; required fields cannot be blank.
credentials.createRefreshFailed: {{operation}}, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.
credentials.deleteRefreshFailed: Credential deleted, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.

bindings.help: The code Credential name lets the script read the bound sensitive value, for example
bindings.helpSuffix: ; the field is injected into the Adapter execution environment as
bindings.injectedSuffix: ; all bindings are replaced on save.
bindings.openSettingsHint: To add a Credential, open System Settings → Credentials.
bindings.nonAdminOpenSettingsHint: To add a credential, ask an administrator to go to “System Settings → Credentials” and create one.
bindings.ownerRisk: Bindings show only Credential names and fields; Secret values are never shown. Owners can change bindings, so bind only trusted Credentials.
bindings.editRisk: This Adapter has bound Credentials. Editors can use them through code and execution, but can never read Secret values; grant Edit only to trusted users.
bindings.renameHint: After changing a code Credential name, update the references in the code too.
bindings.validationEnvKeyRequired: Every binding must have a code Credential name
bindings.validationEnvKeyDuplicate: Code Credential names must be unique
bindings.validationSelectionRequired: Every binding must select a Credential and field

packageSources.nameAndUrlRequired: Enter a package source name and index URL.
packageSources.name: Package source name
packageSources.urlInvalid: Enter a valid package source URL. Your input has been kept for correction.
packageSources.defaultCheckbox: Set as default for this type
packageSources.setDefault: {{name}} is now the default package source
packageSources.createRefreshFailed: Package source created, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.
packageSources.deleteRefreshFailed: Package source deleted, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.
packageSources.setDefaultRefreshFailed: {{name}} is now the default package source, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.
packageSources.restoreDefaultRefreshFailed: Restored {{kind}} defaults, but the list did not refresh. Refresh before retrying.
packageSources.emptyDefaults: Default sources are not loaded. Refresh and try again.
packageSources.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}} ({{url}}) as the {{kind}} default? This adds the domestic and official sources, selects the domestic source, and preserves custom sources and credential bindings.
packageSources.fallbackNotice: No default {{kind}} source is configured. The Worker uses local cache only and fails explicitly if it is insufficient; it will not use an unconfigured URL. Restore a default or create one.

knowledgeSources.description: Configure a read-only knowledge source and verify the knowledge bases it can access. Tencent ima is supported first.
knowledgeSources.credentialNotice: Only the credential reference is stored; Client ID, API Key and other Secret values are never shown.
knowledgeSources.endpointNotice: Tencent ima’s official URL is used by default; custom URLs require DLR_IMA_ENDPOINT.
knowledgeSources.testSucceeded: Connection passed; knowledge base list refreshed.
knowledgeSources.testFailed: Connection failed. Check the credential and deployment network.
knowledgeSources.noKnowledgeBases: No knowledge bases yet. Test the connection first.

builtin.intro: DLR builtin dependency source: materials are stored on Control
builtin.uploadIsNotInstallable: Uploaded files may still have missing dependencies. Check on the target Worker. The builtin source never fills missing packages from public repositories.
builtin.capacity: Total capacity · shared by all languages
builtin.sourceSelected: {{language}} now uses the DLR builtin source for new tasks.
builtin.unspecified: Determined by package and Worker runtime
builtin.checkHint: Select a saved adapter and target Worker to check its dependencies. Business code is not executed. The check creates a labeled execution and uses the normal task queue and resource budget.
builtin.checkAccepted: Check #{{id}} is queued for the selected Worker.
builtin.capacityHint: The default is 1024 MiB (1 GiB) shared by all languages. The limit counts saved files and upload reservations, excluding Worker environments. It cannot be set below current usage.
builtin.deleted: The file and download endpoint have been removed.
builtin.deleteWarning: The Control file is physically deleted without a recoverable copy. Existing Worker environments may keep running, but new Workers or reclaimed caches may not be reinstallable. Active tasks and downloads block deletion.
builtin.controlHosted: Managed by Control; no URL required
builtin.checkInLibrary: Check installation in the builtin library

uploadHint.pypi: Upload .whl files matching the target Worker and include every dependency. Only wheels are accepted; Control does not build source distributions.
uploadHint.npm: Upload npm pack .tgz files and all related packages. Direct URL, Git and local-path dependencies are rejected. Lifecycle scripts are disabled during installation.
uploadHint.maven: Choose the repository root to preserve group/artifact/version paths in a batch, or provide a directory for individual files. Include JARs, POMs, metadata, maven-dependency-plugin 3.8.1 and its dependencies.
uploadHint.goproxy: Upload .mod, .info and .zip files including transitive modules. Preserve module/@v/version paths; choose the proxy root for directory uploads.
